title: Invoice
key_sentences: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
Thank you for asking us to fit out the reading room at the institute.
The shelving was installed on 9 October and signed off by the building committee the same afternoon.
The oak has been finished with two coats of hardwax oil.
Our workmanship guarantee runs for five years from the date of installation.

notes: Single-page supplier invoice. Letterhead (organisation name and two address lines) and footer are furniture; the organisation name is not a heading. "BILL TO" and "DELIVER TO" are two boxes side by side, read box by box (left box fully, then right box); their labels are form labels, not headings, and their address lines are not a table. Table 1 is a boxed key/value panel with no header row (left column shaded). Table 2 has rules under the header and above the subtotal only; "Materials" and "Labour" are section rows spanning all five columns, and Subtotal/VAT/Total due span the first four columns, so their text repeats in each covered cell. Payment terms are a typed decimal list ("1." markers in the text, hanging indent). Notes on the work is a CSS-drawn bullet list (disc at level 0, circle at level 1); its markers are not in the text.
